# About this edition {.unnumbered}

This volume brings together Parts I–IV of *Recursively Realized Distinguishability (R²D)*, Canon revision 2026-09-25. It is rendered from publication copies of the authoritative Markdown masters; the masters remain the source of truth.

The September 14, 2026 integrated PDF remains an archival publication baseline. Each Part’s distinctions among definitions, derivations, postulates, physical mappings, and open questions remain in force.

This Parts I–IV volume does not include the addenda.
